Was told it had just come in from manufacturers & should be dispatched same day.Delivery finally happened on Sept 2nd.Very happy with the products ordered, just feel there needs to be better clarity over what is "in stock", delivery schedules & communication given if a delay is likely rather than the consumer having to chase.

My wife chose Purple Plum Catering for our wedding celebration in May 2018 and we were disappointed with the outcome. Meetings to discuss arrangements were cancelled at short notice and communication was poor before the event. On the day the proprietor, Julia, didn't even turn up and the whole affair was delegated. In fairness to the guy who was on the spot, he did well, but the service and the food failed to meet expectations and there was absolutely no contact afterwards to see if we were satisfied. In retrospect, I should have seen it coming when she demanded payment in full prior to the event. I've no doubt that they can do a great job when they want to and the reviews on here would back that up, but they don't always and my advice would be to withhold the fee until you've had the service.

Considering your paying a lot of money I did not expect that bad quality. Given 2 stars as they have let us return them , but seeing other reviews I hope we get the refund !
